messages.subject: Project Willow - first 13-week cashflow
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

First 13-week cash flow attached for onward provision to the Bank under the standstill. Closing cash stays above £1.0m throughout; the lumpy weeks are payroll (4-weekly) and the March interest payment. Let me know if the Bank wants a different format.

Robert Dukes
CFO, Calverton Industries Limited
